Text and Performance Quarterly 2026-07-30

Grief-time in Wave 1.12.22

Michael Tristano Jr.

This essay responds to Desirée Rowe’s Wave 1.12.22. I read Rowe’s performance as an experiment in grief-time. Through a Black and women of color feminist reading of Rowe’s performance, I demonstrate the utility of grief-time, what it makes visible of our social landscapes, and consider it an equipment for living for other worldings.
